text:
maya: quick note from cadence with CS + one pilot: they love a simple, opinionated playbook SDK rather than many knobs. ask = clear defaults for batching + cache, a conservative quant path, eval-driven alerts, and an easy experiment flag.
igor: agree. we should ship defaults that work for "chatty" apps and a small surface for power users. avoid too many toggles in MVP.
anita: proposed MVP checklist (short):
- SDK: single boolean toggle for Optimize (on/off) + advanced flags buried in SDK options
- Telemetry: per-route p95 latency, cache_hit_rate, tokens_saved_pct, and billing_delta_tagged
- Quant: INT8 dynamic as default, 4-bit as opt-in alpha behind flag
- Alerts: daily eval job + drift detector; alerts start in slack-dryrun mode for 7 days
- Docs: 1-page quickstart + 2 example playbooks (support and FAQ)
lee: want a clear experiment flow: sandbox -> pilot -> gradual ramp. each step must include a noise-suppression checklist for alerts.
maya: pilot success metrics suggestion:
- business metric: tokens cost delta >= 12% for batch profile
- quality metric: concordance_drop <= 1% on customer eval
- perf metric: p95 <= 160ms for target request mix (8-80 token prompts, median 22 tokens)
igor: add operational metric: rollback time <= 10 minutes for pilot traffic; and an option to pin a float variant for immediate failover.
anita: alert rule examples (plain text):
- daily_eval.concordance_delta <= -2% -> slack-dryrun (7d) -> then page-oncall
- realtime.token_logprob_shift >= 0.18 -> slack-only, mark for triage
- eval_job.failed_tests > 0 -> open incident + auto-tag build for rollback candidate
lee: implement a dry-run annotation on alerts so we can capture noise rates before enabling pages. also store alert evaluation history in the eval traces.
maya: rollout plan: internal alpha (eng + cs), single-customer pilot (~2 weeks), expanded pilot (3 customers), GA. each stage has gating checklist.
igor: infra deps: runtime batching knobs, shared prefix cache (eng-infra), telemetry schema (eng-platform), alerting hooks (eng-sre). please list owners in the board.
anita: minimal console work for MVP: one toggled card per route showing cache_hit_rate and tokens_saved_pct, with link to playbook. deeper UX later.
lee: on billing - tag pilot traffic so we can compute revenue-weighted cost delta and avoid skew from test traffic. also add a per-customer cost-savings dashboard tile.
maya: customer acceptance test for pilot: run their standard eval + 48h of real traffic. require concordance_drop <=1% and cost improvement threshold. if fail, iterate quant or reduce batch sizes.
igor: risks: alert noise, quant edge cases on long context, batching latency tail. mitigations: alert dry-run window, 4-bit opt-in only after internal alpha, batch size caps with per-request short-circuit.
anita: next actions:
- anita: draft playbook + acceptance checklist (EOD tomorrow)
- igor: runtime scope & perf risk doc (2d)
- lee: telemetry schema + billing tags (3d)
- maya: coordinate pilot onboarding + CS runbook (3d)
devops-bot: scheduled deploy: optimize-playbook-alpha -> staging 2024-11-06T03:00Z. will ping #eng-releases.
maya: thanks all — keeping scope tight. we'll reconvene after drafts. :rocket:
